heavenlyrestriction.skill.prospector.des: Toggle: +50% mining speed and +3 effective Fortune, added to your tool's Fortune. Stone and deepslate have a 1% chance to yield an extra resource when mined with a suitable tool. When mastered, the find chance becomes 1.5% and rarer materials become more likely. Sense ore deposits within 32 blocks through terrain, including magic ore; ore types have distinct marker colors and glyphs. Press Refine to open Tensura's refining menu. No aura or magicule cost.
heavenlyrestriction.skill.exponentiation: Passive, In Slot. Raise beneficial final stats and outputs to the power of 1.2 while equipped in your active preset: damage, HP/SHP healing, aura/magicule recovery, defenses, elemental bonuses, senses, learning/mastery, EP awards before the race split, non-energy capacities, mining, attack/casting speed, loot quantities and XP gains. Maximum aura/magicules and separate permanent aura/magicule gain multipliers, movement-related values, costs, cooldowns and requirements are excluded. Fractions below 1 are preserved, and native chance, stack and progression limits apply. No activation or upkeep cost.
heavenlyrestriction.skill.split_mind.des: Toggle: +9 learning and mastery point gain, native Thought Acceleration and Chant Annulment (mastered magic casts instantly). Magic Assignment: choose one of your learned aspectual or spiritual magics. Auto-Cast: independently toggle automatic casting at the nearest visible hostile mob or combat opponent within 32 blocks. Normal magic costs, casting requirements and cooldowns apply. Allies and protected players are excluded. When Split Mind is mastered, Auto-Cast costs 25% fewer magicules; aura costs and manual casting costs are unchanged.
heavenlyrestriction.split_mind.invalid: This learned magic is no longer available.
